content.text: Repair Ky option merging. Nested user data (especially json fields named headers, hooks, searchParams or context) must remain ordinary data, rather than receiving root-option special handling. Class instances such as a dispatcher must retain identity when supplied through create, extend or request overrides. Preserve the existing semantics for real root headers/hooks/searchParams/context, arrays, plain objects and null-prototype objects. Investigate the public request and factory paths and verify the fix.

content.text:
Implemented the repair in `source/utils/merge.ts`.

- Restricted special handling for `headers`, `hooks`, `searchParams`, and `context` to root options, so nested JSON fields remain ordinary data.
- Restricted recursive merging to arrays and plain objects, including null-prototype objects. Class instances such as dispatchers now retain identity instead of being converted into plain objects during overrides.
- Preserved root-option merging and explicit replacement behavior.

Reviewed the shared factory/request merge paths and request normalization. All 3 visible tests passed. Only the production merge source was modified.
